map.涤棉轧染色差核查示例: Example colour difference check for polyester-cotton pad dyeing
map.织物为涤棉混纺，轧余率参考 60%~70%，实测 82% 偏高提示带液过多易泳移: For a polyester-cotton blend with a reference pickup of 60%~70%, the measured 82% is high and indicates excess liquor loading with migration risk; the left/centre/right ΔEcmc are 0.6/0.4/1.3, and the right side exceeds the customer tolerance of 1.0, so it is judged fail and the pad pressure needs adjusting.
map.轧染后织物带液重占干布重的百分数，决定实际带液量，直接影响得色深度与匀染，是轧染: The percentage of wet fabric weight relative to dry fabric weight after pad dyeing, which determines the actual liquor loading and directly affects shade depth and levelness — a key process parameter in pad dyeing.
map.左右色差怎么来的？: Where does the left/right colour difference come from?
map.多见于轧车左右压力不均、预烘温度梯度或导布偏移，使布面带液或烘干不一致，表现为左: It usually comes from uneven left/right pad pressure, pre-drying temperature gradients or fabric tracking offset, making liquor loading or drying inconsistent across the width, which shows up as left/centre/right colour difference.
map.色差多少算合格？: What colour difference counts as pass?
map.视客户合同，常见 ΔEcmc≤1.0~2.0；本工具按参考范围分级，最终以封样与: It depends on the customer contract; commonly ΔEcmc≤1.0~2.0. This tool grades by the reference range, and the sealed sample plus actual measurement take precedence.
map.轧染是连续染色的重要工艺，轧余率决定带液量，色差 ΔE 反映前后色一致性。本工具: Pad dyeing is an important continuous dyeing process, where the pickup determines liquor loading and the colour difference ΔE reflects front/back colour consistency. This tool assesses the reasonableness of the pickup and the pass rate of the colour difference by fabric type, helping judge quickly whether the pad dyeing process meets the standard.
